metadata.description: Free Claude plugins for Amazon sellers: PPC search terms, Search Query Performance share, listing rules, product margins.

plugins.name: termsweep
plugins.description: Finds wasted Amazon Sponsored Products spend in your search term report: bleeding search terms to negate, too-expensive converting terms, and winners to add as exact keywords. Works with reports in any console language (EN/DE and more); runs locally, without access to your Amazon account.

plugins.name: keywordshare
plugins.description: Reads the Brand Analytics Search Query Performance report and shows your impression, click, cart-add and purchase share per search query, where the funnel leaks, the biggest visibility gaps, strong queries to defend and a keyword list for your listing. Runs locally, without access to your Amazon account.

plugins.name: listingdoctor
plugins.description: Checks Amazon listings against Amazon's current rules (75-character titles since July 2026, Item Highlights, bullets, 249-byte backend search terms, forbidden characters and claims) and EU law (EmpCo eco claims, GPSR, textile labelling). Score plus the top 5 fixes per listing, from a category listing report, flat file, ASINs or pasted text. Runs locally, never changes your listings.

plugins.name: margencheck
plugins.description: Rechnet ein Produkt aus einem Lieferantenangebot durch: Landed Cost je Stück (EK, Fracht See/Bahn/Luft, Zoll, EUSt, Prep, Inbound), Amazon-Gebühren nach der EU-Tarifübersicht 2026 (Verkaufsgebühr, FBA-Größenklasse, Niedrigpreisversand, Lager inkl. Q4, Retouren) oder Shopify-Kosten, Deckungsbeitrag, Break-even-ACOS/TACOS, Max-EK für die Verhandlung, Kapitalbedarf und GO/TEST/NEIN. Gebühren als datierte Tabelle mit Quelle, Rechnung deterministisch in Python, läuft lokal.
